parameters.help_en:
The resource ID. Currently, only driver resources are supported. Set this parameter to the driver ID.

You can obtain the driver ID by hovering over the target driver name on the Driver Management page in the IoT Platform console (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list). You can also call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155776.html operation to obtain the driver ID
parameters.help_zh:
资源ID。目前仅支持驱动资源，因此此处为驱动ID。

可在边缘计算控制台 (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的驱动管理页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标驱动名称上获取驱动ID。您也可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155776.html接口获取驱动ID
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. Leave this parameter empty for public instances. Specify this parameter for Enterprise instances
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The file content type. Valid values:

DRIVER_VERSION_CONTENT: the code of a driver version.
DRIVER_VERSION_DEFAULT_CONFIG: the default configurations of a driver version.
INSTANCE_DRIVER_VERSION_CONFIG: the configuration of a driver version for an edge instance
parameters.help_zh:
文件内容类型。有如下三种类型：

DRIVER_VERSION_CONTENT：驱动某一版本的代码。
DRIVER_VERSION_DEFAULT_CONFIG：驱动某一版本的默认配置。
INSTANCE_DRIVER_VERSION_CONFIG：边缘实例驱动某一版本的配置
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The edge instance ID. You can obtain the ID by hovering over the target edge instance name on the Edge Instances page in the IoT Platform console (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list).

You can also call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135214.html operation to obtain the ID.

This parameter is required when Type is set to INSTANCE_DRIVER_VERSION_CONFIG
parameters.help_zh:
边缘实例ID。在边缘计算控制台 (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的边缘实例页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标边缘实例名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135214.html接口获取。

当Type参数取值为INSTANCE_DRIVER_VERSION_CONFIG时，此项不可为空
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The resource version. Currently, only driver resources are supported. Set this parameter to the driver version
parameters.help_zh: 资源版本。目前仅支持驱动资源，因此此处为驱动版本
